SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 76
Date............12.3.29

March 12th,    9

CONFIDENTIAL.

Dear Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter and enclosures of February 27 regarding
Mr. A.V. Nash, who is suspected of having stolen
certain monies from the safe of the Municipal
Waterworks, Tientsin, and to inform you in reply
that Mr. Nash arrived in Shanghai on March 3 and
left with his wife by the S.S. "Andre Lebon" for
Hongkong on March 9. While here, Nash lived with
his brother-in-law, Mr. F.W. Ambrose, Chief
Inspector in the Health Department, S.M.C., at
No. 58 Edinburgh Road. Efforts made to shadow
Nash were found impracticable, but so far as
could be ascertained he did not attend any
entertainments other than private parties.

Yours faithfully,

A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

Assistant Superintendent of Police,
British Concession,
Tientsin.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 76
日期............1929年3月12日

3月12日，    9

机密。

敬启者：

兹确认收到阁下2月27日来函及附件，关于A.V. 纳什先生涉嫌从天津工部局自来水厂保险柜窃取若干款项一事。现复告如下：纳什先生于3月3日抵达上海，并于3月9日与其妻子乘“安德烈·勒邦”号（S.S. "Andre Lebon"）轮船前往香港。在沪期间，纳什与其姐夫、工部局卫生处总督察F.W. 安布罗斯先生同住于爱丁堡路58号。虽曾试图对纳什进行跟踪监视，但发现此举不可行；据查，除私人聚会外，他未参加其他任何娱乐活动。

此致

敬礼，

代理刑事侦缉处处长。

天津英租界
警署副总监收。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
CENTRAL I. B.
REPORT
Date March 11, 1929.
Subject (in full) Mr. A. W. Nash.
Made by D.I. Robertson Forwarded by
With reference to the attached letter of February 27,
1929 from the Acting Superintendent of Police, Tientsin, re
Mr. A. W. Nash, inquiries show that during his stay in Shanghai
he resided with his brother-in-law, Mr. F.W. Ambrose, who is
employed in the Health Department, at 58 Edinburgh Road, and
with his wife and infant left in the S.S. "Andre Lebon" for
Hongkong on March 9. As the only entertainment Mr. Nash took
part in during his stay in Shanghai consisted of private
house parties it was impossible to shadow him.
H. Robertson
D. I.
A/ D.C.I.
C.S.D. Rog.
Please draft letter in above
sense in reply to the communication from
Tientsin which is attached. When the
draft is ready, please show it to me
before passing to A.D.C.I. for signature.
M.G.
11/3/29

关于附上的1929年2月27日天津代理警署总监有关A. W. 纳什先生的来信，经查询，纳什先生在沪期间与其姐夫F.W. 安布罗斯先生同住于爱丁堡路58号，安布罗斯先生任职于卫生处。纳什先生与其妻及婴儿于3月9日乘“安德烈·勒邦”号轮船离开上海前往香港。由于纳什先生在沪期间参与的唯一娱乐活动仅为私人家庭聚会，故无法对其进行跟踪监视。
H. 罗伯逊

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.: 76
Date............4. 3. 29

TELEGRAPHIC ADDRESS: "BRITMUPAL"

Council Offices,
Tientsin.

POLICE DEPARTMENT.

CONFIDENTIAL    27th. February, 1929.

Director,
Criminal Investigation Dept.
Shanghai.
------------------

Dear Sir,

On the 5th. inst., the sum of $3151.00 made up as
per enclosure was found missing from the safe of the
Municipal Waterworks. The money was deposited in the safe on
receipt from the bank in the morning by Mr. Nash and a Chinese
named Liu, both in the employ of the Waterworks. When the safe
was opened at 2 p.m. the money was found to be missing. Up to
the present we have been unable to trace the money. The
employees give satisfactory accounts of themselves and we are
now wondering if Mr. N. yielded to the temptation as he was
going on leave, and removed the money during the tiffin hour;
He had admission to the office though we are unable to trace
that he actually did so between 12.15 and 2.5 p.m.

As Mr. N. will be staying in Shanghai, I would appreciate any
assistance you may be able to render by having him shadowed
and note if he by any chance might change any of the notes of
the Banks mentioned in the enclosure.

Yours faithfully,

H. S. Almond
Acting Superintendent.

A.C. (Pol.)
I cannot see that our
enquiries on the lines suggested
will help much to prove theft.
anyone may have such notes.
&c: might try
4/3/29
Sear

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D.: 76
日期............1929年3月4日

电报挂号：“BRITMUPAL”

天津。
理事会办公室。

警务处。

机密    1929年2月27日。

致：
上海
刑事侦缉处处长
------------------

敬启者：

本月5日，发现工部局自来水厂保险柜内短少一笔款项，计3151.00元，明细见附件。该笔款项系由自来水厂雇员纳什先生和一名姓刘的华人于上午从银行取回后存入保险柜。下午2时开启保险柜时，发现款项失踪。截至目前，我们尚无法追踪该笔款项的下落。涉事员工的陈述令人满意，我们现在怀疑纳什先生因即将休假而未能抵挡诱惑，在午餐时间将钱款拿走；虽然他有权进入办公室，但我们无法查证他在中午12:15至下午2:05之间是否确实进入过办公室。

鉴于纳什先生将逗留上海，如蒙协助对其实施跟踪监视，并注意他是否有可能兑换附件中提及的银行钞票，本人将不胜感激。

此致

敬礼，

H. S. 阿尔蒙德
代理总监。

A.C. (Pol.)
我看按建议的方向进行调查，
对证实盗窃案帮助不大。
任何人都可能持有此类钞票。
等等：可以尝试
1929年3月4日
西尔
